description:
Hi there! We are Team AUPET, competing in the  2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about technology, engineering, and space innovation, and we are tackling the "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" challenge.
Our goal is to build a smart, user-friendly solution to help keep astronauts safe and healthy in deep space. We are looking for motivated teammates with skills in software and web development, coding!
